learnings.question: Who first articulated the idea, in 1971, that an overload of information necessarily creates a scarcity of attention?
learnings.learning: Herbert Simon observed in 1971 that in an information-rich world, the wealth of information creates a scarcity of attention, since attention is what information consumes.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: In a well-known hadith found in the 40 Hadith an-Nawawi collection, what is described as part of the perfection of a person's Islam?
options: Leaving that which does not concern him
learnings.learning: Hadith 12 of the 40 Hadith an-Nawawi states that part of the perfection of one's Islam is leaving that which does not concern him — a basis for filtering out distractions that don't deserve your attention.
learnings.articleTitle: Everybody wants your attention, but not everything deserves it.

learnings.question: What term, associated with research on the 'Google Effect,' describes the brain's tendency to forget information once it has been saved digitally?
learnings.learning: Researchers behind the 'Google Effect' paper call the brain's habit of discarding information as soon as it's saved digitally 'Digital Amnesia.'
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: Which 19th-century psychologist demonstrated that people forget roughly 80% of newly learned material within 24 hours unless they actively recall it?
learnings.learning: Back in the 1880s, Hermann Ebbinghaus proved that people forget about 80% of what they learn within 24 hours unless they actively force themselves to recall it, which is the basis for spaced repetition.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: In the Scrum framework, which artifact is used to visualize a sprint's progress by showing how much work remains?
learnings.learning: The Burndown Chart visualizes the progress of a Sprint, showing remaining work and helping the team track whether they are on schedule.

learnings.question: What is the primary purpose of dividing a software development project into short, iterative cycles known as Sprints?
options: To reduce the number of team members needed
To allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments
To eliminate the need for planning meetings
To increase the overall length of the project
learnings.learning: Scrum breaks a project into smaller, iterative cycles called Sprints specifically to allow for more flexibility and quicker adjustments.

learnings.question: What Arabic term describes a state of mindful God-consciousness that builds self-restraint and purifies a person's intentions?
learnings.learning: Taqwa is an awareness of Allah's presence that builds self-restraint and purifies intentions, and worship is described as fostering it.

learnings.question: According to a verse in the Quran, besides humankind, what other type of being was said to be created for the purpose of worship?
learnings.learning: Quran 51:56 states, 'I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me,' naming jinn alongside humans as created for worship.

learnings.question: Which hadith collection records the Prophet Muhammad's statement that there would be no prophet after him, but that there would be caliphs?
learnings.learning: Sahih Bukhari 3455 records the Prophet Muhammad saying, 'There will be no prophet after me; instead, there will be caliphs,' underscoring the ongoing human role as stewards (khalifah).

learnings.question: In PCIe power management, which state describes a device that is almost completely powered down, offering the highest power savings but requiring the longest time to wake up?
learnings.learning: The L2 state is where a PCIe device is almost completely powered down, used for the longest periods of inactivity, giving the highest power savings and the longest wake-up time.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In an analogy comparing PCIe power states to everyday computer use, which state is likened to a computer screen turning off — less active, but able to quickly resume full operation?
learnings.learning: L0s is compared to a computer screen turning off: a very light sleep state designed for short idle periods that can quickly wake up to resume activity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe

learnings.question: In Islamic theology, what term refers to Allah's complete and eternal plan, already written, for every event that will ever occur?
learnings.learning: Qadr is everything that Allah has planned and written for our lives, encompassing His complete and eternal knowledge of everything that will ever happen — distinct from Qada', the actual unfolding of events.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: Which hadith collection records the saying that a Muslim's supplication to Allah is never wasted — he either grants it, or wards off an equivalent evil — unless the request itself is sinful?
learnings.learning: Jami at-Tirmidhi 3573 records that there is no Muslim who supplicates to Allah without being granted it or having an equivalent evil averted, unless the supplication is for something sinful.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: What term describes the small diacritical markings placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate vowel sounds and pronunciation?
learnings.learning: Tashkeel are small markings placed above or below Arabic letters to indicate how they should be pronounced, similar to how vowels work in English.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: When the 80/20 Pareto Principle was tested against word frequency in the Quran, what percentage of the text did the top 20 most frequent words actually account for?
learnings.learning: Contrary to the Pareto Principle's 80/20 expectation, the top 20 most frequent words in the Quran accumulate to only about 20.83% of the text.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python
